label: SIMULATOR POLICY BENCHMARK ON AN UNCALIBRATED FREE-BURN STRESS SCENARIO; NOT PHYSICAL VALIDATION
interpretation: Every frozen base PPO (trained at B=2) lowers added burned area versus no-op at B=1, 2 and 4 on the 20 VALIDATION fires; seed-averaged -5.1, -16.6 and -19.7 ha against 324.3 ha no-op, with scenario-bootstrap intervals below zero.

Budget-specific fine-tuning shows no measurable gain: fine-tuned minus frozen base is -0.4 ha at B=1 and +0.6 ha at B=4; fine-tuned minus matched control is +0.9 and -1.6 ha; all intervals include zero.
The downwind heuristic (-28.0 ha at B=2 and B=4) is at least as good as the PPO average; several seeds converge on the same downwind behaviour.
With 90-minute active cells most simulated fires stop within the first 12h, so budgets above 1-2 units rarely find a legal line; this limits any budget-adaptation signal.
Effects are 2-9% of no-op damage; one 1.26 km line per crew shift is small relative to these fires. Results describe SimFire policy behaviour only.
